description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the evolution of the absolute mean of hidden states across different layers for three distinct configurations: the hidden state mean before the gate, the hidden state mean after the gate, and the hidden state mean of a baseline model. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 22 in integer increments, representing the depth of the neural network. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, indicating the magnitude of the hidden state mean. The blue dashed line, representing the hidden state mean before the gate, starts at approximately 0.1 and remains relatively stable until layer 18, after which it exhibits a sharp increase, reaching a value of approximately 4.3 at layer 22. The orange dotted line, corresponding to the hidden state mean after the gate, remains consistently low and flat, hovering just above 0 across all layers, with an average value of 0.05 as indicated in the legend. The green solid line, which shows the hidden state mean of the baseline, is nearly flat and stays at a very low value, close to 0, with an average of 0.04. This indicates that the gating mechanism significantly suppresses the hidden state mean after the gate, while the baseline model maintains a minimal mean throughout the layers.
